_comment: Copy to laminar.dev.json (team self-hosted instance) or laminar.localhost.json (local compose). Both are gitignored. The app reads .dev.json first, then .localhost.json; in an installed build they go in the app's resources folder. See AGENTS.md, 'Tracing agent and chat turns (Laminar)'. Delete both files to switch tracing off.
projectApiKey: <project settings of the instance you are pointing at>
_endpointComment: Where that instance is. baseUrl carries no port; the defaults below are the docker-compose stack's, so a local instance needs only the key. The team's self-hosted instance is https://api.laminar.aipg.aws.thenerdgroup.ai with httpPort 443 and grpcPort 8443.
_maxCharsComment: Optional. How much of each recorded message list to keep; the Pi extension's own default of 20000 clips the newest messages and hides the prompt of every turn after the first.
